X_r is defined on V over ℂ for each nonnegative integer r by the action power divided by r!, with X_0 the identity. These factorials are nonzero finite products in ℂ. No reduction or lattice preservation is assumed; those properties occur separately in N001, N002 and N005.

U_Z is precisely the ℤ-subalgebra generated by the two divided-power families in the stated universal enveloping algebra, with the action determined by the given representation. Jcoord_i is the preimage of the R-linear image ι_R(M_R) under c↦ce_i, so is an R-submodule by the defining additivity/scalar operations. It is meaningful even before the embedding identification.
